translated_title: DHS Says Durazo and Villarreal Have No 'Parole' Permit to Enter U.S.
original_title: DHS niega que Alfonso Durazo y Américo Villarreal tengan permisos especiales para ingresar a EU
author: La Redacción
meta_description: After reports of cancelled visas, La Opinión asked DHS whether the Morena governors of Sonora and Tamaulipas hold 'Parole' permits. The answer: no.
